messages:
sarah: FYI invoice INV-2028-4019 (Helio Core) for $96,000 posted today. System recognized as one-time revenue but contract says $24k services + $72k prepaid capacity over 6 months starting 2028-06-01. Need correcting JE and rev-schedule mapping before close.

mike: Can you paste the invoice line breakout and the contract effective date?

sarah: Lines: Service: 24000 (svc-impl), Capacity: 72000 (cap-6mo). Contract start 2028-06-01 per SOW. Billing posted 2028-05-31. No credits/taxes here.

ledger-bot: Invoice INV-2028-4019 created at 2028-05-31T16:20:11Z. Alloc_tag: ONE_TIME_REV.

ana: Proposed fix: leave 24k recognized, reverse 72k into deferred. JE draft: Date 2028-05-31, Debit Rev 72,000, Credit Deferred 72,000. Memo: reclass prepaid capacity INV-2028-4019 to unearned (6-month schedule).

mike: Confirm GLs: Rev = 4100, Deferred = 2200. Tag: ME-MAY-Adj3. Include invoice PDF + SOW extract. Who will update RevSchedule mapping?

sarah: I'll update RevSchedule to map item cap-6mo -> 6mo start 2028-06-01 and attach screenshot. Queue JE in NetSuite.

ledger-bot: JE queued NS-595210 by sarah at 2028-05-31T18:02:05Z. Status: Pending Approval.

mike: Approved once attachments present. Run rev-rec batch test and attach rollforward snapshot. Need ARR note: capacity portion counts toward committed ARR.

sarah: Attachments added, test run attached. Rollforward shows Mar-May no change; Jun onward monthly recognition +12k for 6 months. JE posted NS-595210 (approved).

ana: Closing loop: update month-end memo under 'Adjustments' and include NS-595210 link. All set. :white_check_mark:
